theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V C : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (c : ℝ), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (hs k)) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ c) → TendstoUniformly hs h atTop → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid d)) (K : NNReal) (us : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ) (u : Euclid d → ℝ), IsOpen O ∧ C ⊆ O ∧ (∀ k, LipschitzWith K (us k)) ∧ LipschitzWith K u ∧ TendstoUniformly us u atTop ∧ (∀ k, ∀ y ∈ O, us k y = hs k (ψ y)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ O, u y = h (ψ y)
